name: jobblast
description: Self-hosted, single-user, $0 job-application assistant: aggregates real postings from free APIs, scores them against your profile, and drafts a tailored resume + cover letter for you to review before you apply.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/jobblast run test
